MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  DECEMBER 2, 2019

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills
Estates, CA 90274, by CHAIR ZIGRANG.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

CHAIR ZIGRANG led those assembled in the salute to the flag.

3.  ROLL CALL

COMMISSIONER’S PRESENT:  Schachter, Scott, Zigrang, Carman, Yoo, Edler

COMMISSIONER’S ABSENT:  Medawar

STAFF MEMBERS PRESENT:  Jeannie Naughton, Planning Manager
  Kelley Thom, Associate Planner
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF NOVEMBER 4,
  2019.

Administrative Assistant Corea noted that the date in Item 4A – Approval of Minutes, within the
Planning Commission Minutes of November 4, will be corrected.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE THE CORRECTED PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF
  NOVEMBER 4, 2019.

There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

NONE

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

Planning Commission Meeting
Minutes, December 2, 2019  1
 COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6-A

There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered.

B.  2019 SEMIANNUAL CODE COMPLIANCE REPORT

COMMISSIONER SCOTT inquired about the encroachment issues at 9 Dobbin Lane. Planning
Manager Naughton stated that no action will be taken until Director of Community Development
and Public Works Wahba speaks to someone at the Consolidated Sewer Maintenance District.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-19-19; APPLICANT: MR. JONATHAN PARK;
  LOCATION: 42 Club View Lane; A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility
  Determination to construct one and two-story additions to a two-story residence and the
  partial conversion of the existing second floor for a new accessory dwelling unit (ADU). A
  Minor Deviation is required to decrease the front yard area by less than 10% and for the
  encroachment of the proposed addition into the required front yard which does not project
  closer to the property line than the forwardmost building line.

Associate Planner Thom presented Planning Application No. PA-19-19 and provided a summary
of the staff report.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT inquired about the Minor Deviation approved previously. Associate
Planner Thom stated that this application will replace the previously approved application.

COMMISSSIONER SCOTT stated that this ADU has interior access and would consider this an
expansion of the main house rather and this violates the city’s policy on ADU’s. Planning Manager
Naughton stated that this was not codified.

The Planning Commissioners held a discussion on their concerns with the massing of this home.

Jonathan Park, Applicant, stated that the reason for the extension of the roof line is due to issues
with leaks, and in order to maintain the deck area, decided to cover it to help address this issue
and make a useable outdoor living space. The addition is mostly to the rear of the property and
will not be visible from the street and away from the neighboring properties. Mr. Park stated that
the owners did not use the ADU clause to make the home larger and rather are planning for the
future to have a trustworthy person live in the ADU when they retire. Mr. Park stated that in his
opinion an interior door would be useful in the case of an emergency.

COMMISSIONER YOO asked if there was thought put into separating the patio from the main
home. Mr. Park stated no, but stated that the length has been reduced. Mr. Park stated that the
desire was to change the look of the 70’s “Chalet Style” look of the home.

Planning Commission Meeting
Minutes, December 2, 2019  2
 CHAIR ZIGRANG asked if there was any consideration given to converting the patio area into an
ADU and separating it from the house. Mr. Park stated that there was consideration given to that
but decided that the ADU over the garage would be a better solution since it was previously a
library and was never used.

COMMISSIONER SCOTT inquired about the size of the home (5,460+ sq. ft.) and stated that this
would be the second largest home in the neighborhood. Mr. Park stated that when the silhouette
was installed, the slope of the home is not visible from the front.

A brief discussion ensued regarding the ADU.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER inquired about how it came to be an ADU. Planning Manager
Naughton stated that the second kitchen made it an ADU.

In response to a question by COMMISSIONER YOO, Planning Manager Naughton stated that
the Planning Commission still has discretion on the design.

COMMISSIONER YOO stated that there is a compatibility and massing issue.

COMMISSIONER EDLER added that the ADU is forcing the massing issue of this home.

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCOTT to,

  CONTINUE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-19-19 TO A DATE UNCERTAIN.

Ayes: Schacther, Scott, Zigrang, Carman, Yoo, Edler
Noes:
Absent: Medawar
Abstain:

8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

None

9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER requested more specific guidelines regarding ADU’s since there
will likely be more applications coming in the new year.

COMMISSIONER YOO inquired about 3 Clear Vista. Planning Manger Naughton stated that at
their last meeting, the City Council did not pull this project up for discussion.

10.  MANAGER ITEMS

A.  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETINGS SCHEDULE 2020.

Planning Commission Meeting
Minutes, December 2, 2019  3
 Planning Manager Naughton stated that there are no pending items for the January meeting and
due to the holidays, recommended cancelling the January 6th Planning Commission meeting.
There being no objection, the Planning Commission agreed to cancel the next meeting.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, NOVEMBER 12, 2019

COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM 11-A

There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

CHAIR ZIGRANG adjourned the meeting at 8:14 p.m. The next adjourned Planning Commission
meeting will be held on Monday, February 3, 2020 in the City of Rolling Hills Estates Council
Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.
